verdict.rationale: The catalog includes recent open-weight models such as OpenAI's GPT-OSS 120B, and a user notes Groq was the only fast provider for Kimi K2 at the time, which hints at reasonably current coverage. However, nothing documents how quickly models arrive after release, and one user reports new models moved to 'call us for quotes', which limits self-serve access. Missing for 10: documented time-to-availability or launch-day support for new open-weight releases, a model release changelog, independent corroboration of fast onboarding, and clear self-serve access to newly added models.
